newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 25.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - June 25.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Wednesday's Daily Variety:
* Newly installed ABC Entertainment Chairman Stuart Bloomberg touted his age -- 47 -- as he accepted the appointment, an apparent reference to a contender for the post, 33-year-old Jamie Tarses.
* TV industry lobbyists and parent advocacy groups continue their debate over revising the new ratings system.
* Wilf Stevenson, the director of the British Film Institute for the past nine years, is expected to depart this fall to take a non-industry job under the new Labour government.
* Craig Hunegs has been named to replace Nancy Tellem as executive vice president of business and financial affairs at Time Warner's Warner Bros. TV.
* Will Smith, whose sang the title track to the Sony Corp's Columbia Pictures film "Men In Black," has signed a multiyear recording pact with Columbia Records.
* The home video arm of News Corp's 20th Century Fox will release a special-edition trilogy of "Star Wars."the popular pics.
